title: Flutter
smart_description: Receives [blue]50%[/blue] less damage from Attacks. Deal attack damage [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:time|times} to [gold]Stun[/gold] it.
notes: A Thieving Hopper power. Reduces damage from powered attacks by 50%. Counts down with each attack received; when the counter reaches 0, the creature is Stunned and stops hovering.
